[[File:Mart Laanemäe.jpg|thumb|Mart Laanemäe]]
'''William Mart Laanemäe''' (born in 1959 in [[Vancouver]], Canada) is an [[Estonia]]n diplomat.<ref name="copenhagen.mfa.ee">{{cite web |title=Ambassador Dr. Mart Laanemäe |url=https://copenhagen.mfa.ee/embassy-contacts/ambassador/ |website=Copenhagen |access-date=17 May 2021}}</ref>

Since 1999 he has worked for [[Estonian Ministry of Foreign Affairs]].<ref name="copenhagen.mfa.ee" />

==Diplomatic posts==
* 1999-2003 Ambassador to Austria, Slovakia, Slovenia, Switzerland. 1999-2001 also Ambassador to Hungary and the Czech Republic<ref name="copenhagen.mfa.ee" />
* 2004-2008 non-resident ambassador to Serbia and Montenegro<ref name="copenhagen.mfa.ee" />
* 2008-2012 Ambassador to Germany<ref name="copenhagen.mfa.ee" />
* 2016-2019 Ambassador to Germany<ref name="copenhagen.mfa.ee" />

In 2007 he was awarded with [[Order of the White Star]], IV class.<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Mart Laanemäe |url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/5313/william-mart-laanemae |website=www.president.ee |access-date=17 May 2021}}</ref>
